testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.persistence.JdbcActionRunStoreTests

testcase.name: the same key with other inputs is KeyReused and changes nothing()
the stored result is the replayable outcome and carries no extra data()
a non-retryable failure is replayed as is()
a retry after a retryable failure records the mutating flag of the new attempt()
one sweep treats a mutating and a non-mutating abandoned run each by its own flag()
sweeping twice does not touch a run that is already finished()
an application of another tenant is refused and leaves no row()
tenants, users, actions and apps are separate key scopes()
the sweeper never turns a recorded ambiguous write into a retryable run()
an abandoned RUNNING NON-mutating run is turned into a retryable timeout, a fresh one is left alone()
another tenant cannot see or finish a run even with the same key and run id()
completing twice or with a foreign run id changes nothing()
concurrent begins of one key produce exactly one owner()
concurrent completes of one run let exactly one win()
mutating is stored with the run, survives a restart and defaults to true when the caller does not say()
a finished run survives a restart and is replayed by a new store instance()
the first call starts, a second one is in progress, completing records the result and later calls replay it()
an abandoned MUTATING run becomes IDEMPOTENCY_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never retryable, and is replayed as it is after a restart()
purge deletes finished records older than the horizon and never a RUNNING one()
an ambiguous write stays unknown and never retryable across a restart, however often it is asked again()
the workspace of a run is derived from its project and a run without an app has none()
a retryable failure restarts with a new run id and attempt + 1, a stale owner cannot complete the new run()
a RUNNING run survives a restart as in progress, it is not started a second time()
